# BNL Community Fixes v2.4.3

Impact VFX and water/lava plane hiding.

## Changes
- New feature: hide explosion/impact VFX (grenades, rockets, cannon hits) — visual particles only, sound and damage unaffected.
- New feature: hide lava/water plane visual surface — collision preserved, only the mesh is hidden.
- Muzzle flash and barrel smoke effects (cannon, rocket) also suppressed when impact VFX hiding is enabled.
- Fixed build preview stuck/unbreakable blocks and hardened prediction rollback (v2.4.2 carry-over).
- Removed font replacement feature (v2.4.2 carry-over).
